raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
### What does this PR do?

Reduce overlapping tensor lifetimes during SGLang bucketed weight sync. A non-fused view that overflows the current bucket is now compacted after that bucket has been consumed. The generator drops references to flushed entries, and the adapter drops `params_batch` after the awaited update, before pulling another bucket.

This preserves `_compact_for_bucket`'s view-cloning guard and DeepSeek-V4 fusion groups. No tensor is released before the awaited update completes.

This does not duplicate #6738 (skip redundant clones for owned tensors), #7139 (always clone views of reused NCCL receive buffers), or #7369 (keep fused parameters together), all of which are merged. Open-PR searches for `get_named_tensor_buckets`, SGLang bucket/lifetime/clone terms, and the related issue/PR numbers found no PR addressing this emission-order and reference-lifetime change. #2605 concerns flattened transfers; #8327's adapter changes concern quantized delta-sync validation.

AI assistance was used for implementation and validation (OpenAI Codex). The human submitter confirmed reviewing every changed line and personally running the relevant tests before submission.

### Checklist Before Starting

- [x] Search for similar PRs: [bucketer searches](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Aopen+%22get_named_tensor_buckets%22), [bucket lifetime searches](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Aopen+%22bucket%22+%22lifetime%22).
- [x] Format the PR title as `[{modules}] {type}: {description}`. Uses `fix`, an allowed type, for a memory-lifetime fix.

### Test

- `python -m pytest -q tests/checkpoint_engine/test_sglang_fusion_bucketing_on_cpu.py tests/workers/rollout/test_sglang_rollout_sharding_manager.py --asyncio-mode=auto -o asyncio_default_fixture_loop_scope=function`: **28 passed** on local CPU and the Linux GPU host. Both runs emitted one existing Ray deprecation warning.
- Six new lifecycle regression cases fail on the unmodified main implementation: clone-before-yield, adapter retention, and consumed tensor retention with sync/async sources and ordinary/fused buckets. The added receive-buffer reuse cases also cover full-span views and fused groups exceeding the bucket target.
- `pre-commit install && pre-commit run --all-files --show-diff-on-failure`: **all hooks passed**.
- Synthetic CUDA IPC experiment on one RTX 4090, PyTorch `2.12.1+cu130`: a reused 128 MiB CUDA receive buffer yields 16 full-span views into 256 MiB buckets. The actual `get_named_tensor_buckets` and `ServerAdapter.update_weights` implementations run; the SGLang HTTP update is replaced by an awaited round trip to a separate process consuming real CUDA IPC tensors. The receiver checks every tensor value and drops its references before acknowledging consumption.

| Implementation | Sender peak allocated CUDA memory, each of 3 trials |
| --- | --- |
| Unmodified main | 768 MiB |
| Generator change only | 640 MiB |
| Adapter change only | 640 MiB |
| Both changes | 384 MiB |

Each trial completed 8 IPC updates and returned to the same 128 MiB live receive buffer. The table includes that buffer. These results isolate the lifetime overlap; they are not an end-to-end SGLang training benchmark or a claim of a 50% reduction in total training memory. No throughput improvement is claimed. The experiment's PyTorch version differs from main's pinned backend version.

### API and Usage Example

No public API, configuration, or usage change.

### Design & Code Changes

- Determine an ordinary tensor's bucket placement before cloning its view. Fused members are still compacted immediately to protect them from upstream buffer reuse, staged until complete, and placed as one indivisible group.
- Replace the `_place`/`flushed` references and leaking entry-loop locals with direct bucket placement and short-lived entry references.
- Delete the adapter's `params_batch` only after `await sgl_update_weights(...)` returns.
- Extend the existing CPU bucketer test file, which is already selected by the CPU CI workflow's `*_on_cpu.py` discovery. The adapter unit test loads the actual method with SGLang imports and the HTTP transport stubbed, so it runs without SGLang or a distributed process group.

### Checklist Before Submitting

- [x] Read the [Contribute Guide](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [x] Apply [pre-commit checks](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#code-linting-and-formatting).
- [ ] Add / Update documentation: not applicable; no user-facing behavior or configuration changes.
- [x] Add tests covered by the existing CPU CI workflow.
- [ ] Request CI in the community channel.
- [ ] Update the `recipe` submodule: not applicable.

         )
+
+
+def test_overflow_yields_before_cloning_next_view(monkeypatch):
+    compacted = []
+    compact = utils._compact_for_bucket
+
+    def track_compaction(tensor):
+        compacted.append(tensor)
+        return compact(tensor)
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(utils, "_compact_for_bucket", track_compaction)
+    views = [torch.arange(8, dtype=torch.uint8)[:] for _ in range(2)]
+
+    async def consume():
+        buckets = get_named_tensor_buckets(iter(zip(("a", "b"), views, strict=True)), 8)

+        assert first[0][1]._base is None

+        second = await anext(buckets)
+        assert len(compacted) == 2
+        assert second[0][1]._base is None
+        torch.testing.assert_close(second[0][1], views[1])
+        await buckets.aclose()
+
+    asyncio.run(consume())
+
+
+def _load_rollout_without_sglang(monkeypatch):
+    # Exercise the real adapter method on CPU; only the SGLang imports and
+    # HTTP adapter are stand-ins. No engine, distributed group, or CUDA is needed.
+    modules = {}
+    for name in (
+        "sglang",
+        "sglang.srt",
+        "sglang.srt.entrypoints",
+        "sglang.srt.entrypoints.engine",
+        "sglang.srt.server_args",
+        "sglang.srt.utils",
+        "sglang.srt.weight_sync",
+        "sglang.srt.weight_sync.utils",
+        "verl.workers.rollout.sglang_rollout.http_server_engine",
+    ):
+        module = modules[name] = ModuleType(name)
+        monkeypatch.setitem(sys.modules, name, module)
+        parent, _, child = name.rpartition(".")
+        if parent in modules:
+            setattr(modules[parent], child, module)
+    modules["sglang.srt.server_args"].ServerArgs = object
+    for name in (
+        "MultiprocessingSerializer",
+        "assert_pkg_version",
+        "is_cuda",
+        "set_prometheus_multiproc_dir",
+        "set_ulimit",
+    ):
+        setattr(modules["sglang.srt.utils"], name, None)
+    for name in ("_preprocess_tensor_for_update_weights", "update_weights"):
+        setattr(modules["sglang.srt.weight_sync.utils"], name, None)
+    modules["verl.workers.rollout.sglang_rollout.http_server_engine"].AsyncHttpServerAdapter = object
+    path = Path(utils.__file__).with_name("sglang_rollout.py")
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("_sglang_bucket_lifetime_rollout", path)
+    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
+    return module
+
+
+def test_adapter_releases_consumed_bucket_after_await(monkeypatch):
+    rollout = _load_rollout_without_sglang(monkeypatch)
+    consumed = []
+    updates = []
+
+    async def init_adapter():
+        pass
+
+    async def update_weights(*, params_batch, **kwargs):
+        refs = [weakref.ref(tensor) for _, tensor in params_batch]
+        updates.append([name for name, _ in params_batch])
+        await asyncio.sleep(0)
+        assert all(ref() is not None for ref in refs)
+        consumed.extend(refs)
+
+    def source():
+        for index in range(4):
+            assert all(ref() is None for ref in consumed), "adapter retained a consumed bucket"
+            yield str(index), torch.zeros(1 << 20, dtype=torch.uint8)[:]
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(rollout, "sgl_update_weights", update_weights)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(rollout, "_uses_quantized_refit", lambda *args: False)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(rollout, "_to_ipc_device", lambda tensor: tensor)
+    adapter = SimpleNamespace(
+        _init_server_adapter=init_adapter,
+        _engine=None,
+        config=SimpleNamespace(checkpoint_engine=SimpleNamespace(update_weights_bucket_megabytes=1)),
+        model_config=SimpleNamespace(hf_config=SimpleNamespace(model_type="test")),
+        device_mesh=None,
+    )
+    asyncio.run(rollout.ServerAdapter.update_weights(adapter, source()))
+    assert updates == [[str(index)] for index in range(4)]
+    assert all(ref() is None for ref in consumed)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("fused", [False, True])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("async_source", [False, True])
+def test_consumed_bucket_released_before_next_compaction(monkeypatch, fused, async_source):
+    consumed = []
+    compact = utils._compact_for_bucket
+
+    def check_compaction(tensor):
+        assert all(ref() is None for ref in consumed), "consumed bucket still retains tensors"
+        return compact(tensor)
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(utils, "_compact_for_bucket", check_compaction)
+
+    def source():
+        if fused:
+            for suffix in DEEPSEEK_V4_FUSION_GROUPS[0]:
+                yield "model.layers.0" + suffix, torch.arange(4, dtype=torch.uint8)[:]
+        else:
+            yield "first", torch.arange(8, dtype=torch.uint8)[:]
+        for name in ("second", "third", "fourth"):
+            yield name, torch.arange(8, dtype=torch.uint8)[:]
+
+    async def async_weights():
+        for item in source():
+            yield item
+
+    async def consume():
+        weights = async_weights() if async_source else source()
+        async for bucket in get_named_tensor_buckets(weights, 8, DEEPSEEK_V4_FUSION_GROUPS):
+            consumed.extend(weakref.ref(tensor) for _, tensor in bucket)
+            del bucket
+        assert all(ref() is None for ref in consumed)
+
+    asyncio.run(consume())
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("fused", [False, True])
+def test_reused_full_span_views_preserve_values(fused):
+    backing = torch.empty(8, dtype=torch.uint8)
+
+    def source():
+        for index in range(6):
+            backing.fill_(index)
+            name = "model.layers." + str(index // 2) + DEEPSEEK_V4_FUSION_GROUPS[0][index % 2] if fused else str(index)
+            yield name, backing[:]
+
+    async def consume():
+        index = 0
+        # A fused pair exceeds the bucket target and must remain indivisible.
+        async for bucket in get_named_tensor_buckets(source(), 8, DEEPSEEK_V4_FUSION_GROUPS):
+            assert len(bucket) == (2 if fused else 1)
+            for _, tensor in bucket:
+                torch.testing.assert_close(tensor, torch.full_like(tensor, index))
+                index += 1
+        assert index == 6
+
+    asyncio.run(consume())
